strategy_recommendations.system-only: Best for: Single-turn queries with large system prompts, repeated identical queries
strategy_recommendations.system-plus-early: Best for: Multi-turn conversations (3-5 turns), balanced caching
strategy_recommendations.aggressive: Best for: Long conversations (10+ turns), maximum savings but higher cache write costs

recommendation: Enable caching for all Anthropic workflows with >3 turns. Use system-plus-early as default strategy.
